$comment: Transfer manifest: old ps-shared-dev (org_N4UZdLq5TfZr8k48) -> new ps-shared-dev (org_TvFDTrpQmCss41sM). One Content Transfer per group, run in order. Run `node transfer.mjs discover` first and adjust: every top-level path here must exist on the source, and its parent must exist on the destination with the same item ID (all of these parents are out-of-the-box folders, so they do).

groups.name: languages
groups.description: Custom languages other starters rely on (en-CA, es-MX, ja-JP...). KeepExistingItem so the destination's own 'en' item is never touched.

groups.name: templates
groups.description: Project templates and branches for every starter (click-click-launch, nextjs-article_starter, angular-starter, lighthouse, lighthouse-global, lighthouse-demo-sites, round-rock-sasquatch-sites).

groups.name: settings
groups.description: Headless SXA module definitions per site collection, and the Lighthouse Lifestyle site template.

groups.name: layout
groups.description: Rendering items, placeholder settings and layouts for every starter.

groups.name: media
groups.description: Media library: every site collection's Project folder plus the shared Feature folders the kits use.

groups.name: content
groups.description: Every site collection and site (site definitions live under Settings/Site Grouping inside each site, so the Sites dashboard picks them up).

groups.name: spe-scripts
groups.description: PowerShell script libraries the starters ship.

$doNotTransfer: /sitecore/system/Settings/Services/Rendering Hosts  - generated from xmcloud.build.json on every authoring deploy and protected; transferring the old ones points Pages at hosts that do not exist in the new org
/sitecore/system/Settings/Services  - editing secrets and API keys are per environment
users and roles  - not supported by these APIs; invite through the Cloud Portal
